result.topic_en: Notes on hypergeometric P-functions: the six transformations of the argument with permuted exponents, an Euler-type integral with four singular points, and a connection formula expressing P(a,b,c,x) through P-functions in 1-x.

methods.what: Six transformations of the independent variable (anharmonic group) with corresponding permutation of the exponent parameters of the P-function
Euler-type integral with four branch points as integral representation
Connection formula expressing P(a,b,c,x) as a combination of P-functions in 1-x with trigonometric coefficients

items.english: P(a,b,c,x) sin bπ equals cos((−b−a+c)/2)π P(−b,−a,c,1−x) minus cos((b−a−c)/2)π P(b,−a,−c,1−x).
